# `run` answers with the reply of the agent.
# (from internal_error::cli_new_check_and_run_work_together)
exec metagente new hello
exec metagente run hello.ag greet name=Ana
stdout '^Hello, Ana!$'
! stderr .

# with one accepted message, the message can be left out
exec metagente run hello.ag name=Ana
stdout '^Hello, Ana!$'

# several agents in a file: the first is the default, --agent picks another
exec metagente run two.ag go
stdout '^first$'
exec metagente run two.ag go --agent Second
stdout '^second$'

# a reply that is not text is printed as JSON
exec metagente run list.ag go
stdout '^\[$'
stdout '^  1,$'

-- two.ag --
agent First
  goal "a"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply "first"
agent Second
  goal "b"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply "second"
-- list.ag --
agent L
  goal "x"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply [1, 2]
